name: beethoven-sites
summary: The university site modules of Beethoven, data only: one site module per university's cluster and one lab module per group's deployment on it.

exports.summary: sites/<site>/site.json and sites/<site>/labs/<lab>.json, each passing tools/check_modules.py against the pinned module schema; hpcworker composes the profiles from them

examples/<site>/site.json and examples/<site>/labs/<lab>.json: universities that do not exist, in the layout of the export modules and passing the same checker, that differ from every deployment wherever a module can and name only reserved hosts (RFC 2606), for a consumer's tests to run beside the deployments; never a deployment, so never composed into a profile that ships
